completion_summary: Identified and reported a phishing email. The email claiming to be from IRS Tax Refund Division contained red flags: suspicious domain (irs-tax-refunds.com instead of official IRS domain), requests for identity verification through third-party link (IRS never does this), and urgent language about claiming refunds (common phishing tactic). Reported as spam to protect user from identity theft and fraud.
